basic_info.description: If you love the energy of a loft but dream of living in Noe Valley, this exceptional garden residence offers the best of both worlds. Set amid lush greenery, this tranquil urban oasis features expansive windows framing verdant garden outlooks of your deeded yard, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and outdoor serenity. The open-concept floor plan showcases unobstructed sightlines, refined finishes, and a flexible sleeping area. The designer kitchen is beautifully appointed with new custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a Thermador refrigerator, and an industrial-style range perfect for the discerning home chef. An inviting dining area and generous living space provide an elegant setting for entertaining, complemented by abundant built-in storage. The updated bath is finished with quartz counters and modern cabinetry, while a spacious walk-in closet offers exceptional storage. Additional highlights include a Murphy bed for guests, a powder room, in-unit laundry, and dedicated storage units in the garage. Just outside is your private, deeded garden an idyllic retreat perfect for morning coffee or an afternoon in the sun. One-car parking completes this rare and stylish offering in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
